name: Boiler water chemical dosing
description: After mechanical deaeration, chemically remove residual dissolved oxygen, maintain alkaline pH for magnetite passivation, neutralise CO2 acidity in condensate with volatile amines, condition residual hardness into removable sludge with phosphate/polymer/chelant, and inhibit foaming and caustic attack. Primary source: https://www.watertechnologies.com/handbook/chapter-11-preboiler-and-boiler-corrosion-control

specifications.value: 8 ppm per 1 ppm O2 + 4 ppm reserve; 45% active in liquid catalysed product
